note: Decode emitter families whose coupled rows BoltBeam proposes itself, from the chip's facts and BoltBeam's own block layouts (collectors/metal_native.METADATA_BYTES, data/quants.json), never from the provider's row list. row_owner subgroup: each subgroup owns whole output rows, so a launch is rows_per_group x subgroup_size threads. lane_split block_code_units: the lanes of a subgroup split one block's code bytes in whole load units of the provider's declared width, so lanes_per_block divides both the block's units and the subgroup. launch_constants: the route's measured constants that become search dimensions.
